skills.name: youtube_production_create_brief
skills.description: Create a durable Telugu YouTube production brief. This starts a draft workflow and never generates or publishes a video.

skills.name: youtube_production_prepare_draft
skills.description: Run the YouTube text specialists on a brief with verified notes or source excerpts and stage a Telugu draft, Gemini prompt, and review notes. Runs no video generation or publishing.

skills.name: youtube_production_stage_draft
skills.description: Stage a Telugu script, sources, storyboard, thumbnail prompt, and metadata as one review package. This never publishes.

skills.name: youtube_production_status
skills.description: Read the current durable state of one YouTube production episode.

skills.name: youtube_production_review_package
skills.description: Read the complete staged review package for one episode, including its exact approval hash.

skills.name: youtube_production_pending_reviews
skills.description: List YouTube production episodes awaiting review or requested revisions.

skills.name: youtube_production_request_changes
skills.description: Record revision feedback for a staged YouTube review package and invalidate any approval.

skills.name: youtube_production_approve
skills.description: Approve the exact current YouTube draft package by its review hash. Draft-only mode records approval but cannot publish or schedule.
